name: The Perfume Journal
description: Editorial fragrance journal for Patélle — scent guides, notes and stories on a WordPress + Elementor site, powered by a custom journal plugin I built.
detail: Live magazine-style storefront and blog at theperfumejournal.com. Layout and pages are WordPress with Elementor; the archive and single-post experience comes from my Patélle Journal plugin — plugin-owned templates, Customizer-style settings for blog grid, featured story, newsletter, reading progress, TOC and design tokens. Theme/Elementor can keep the header and footer while the plugin takes over post views.
